posts.hook: Nvidia raises AI chip prices and bankrolls a DeepSeek rival, same week
posts.caption: nvidia hikes ai server prices 15%+ while its poolside deal quietly targets an open-weight rival to deepseek, iran-linked hackers took down a uk power plant for four days, and a london ai lab says its agent just beat gpt-5.5 at reproducing research. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)
